title: Detention
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, old brick adult night school after dark, flickering fluorescent classrooms and long empty hallways, chalk dust in the air, sickly green and sodium orange tones, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. She stayed after class. The clock ran backwards. 🕰️

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Mr. Grey's lesson plan crossed out five of Carla's students, and listed her as his substitute.
scenes.image: a leather folder lying open on a car seat at night, a grey pencil beside it

scenes.narration: Nobody was at the window when she looked again. Just fog. In the morning, she called the five students. Dale's number was disconnected. Marisol's belonged to a laundromat.
scenes.image: a woman on the phone in a grey morning kitchen, worried, rain on the window

scenes.narration: Their desks at Eastgate were still there. Pushed to the back. Coated in fine grey dust, as if they'd been empty for years.
scenes.image: five old wooden desks at the back of a classroom covered in thick grey dust

scenes.narration: Thursday, after class, Carla didn't leave. If he only comes when she's gone, she wouldn't go. She'd stay all night.
scenes.image: a woman sitting alone at a teacher's desk in an empty classroom at night, arms crossed

scenes.narration: Nine o'clock, the building went quiet. Nine thirty, the janitor's cart squeaked past and faded. At ten, the hallway lights clicked off, one by one.
scenes.image: a long dark school hallway with ceiling lights going out one after another

scenes.narration: She looked up at the clock. The second hand was sweeping the wrong way.
scenes.image: a round classroom wall clock with a plain face and no numbers, its hands blurred in motion

scenes.narration: The chalk dust in the tray began to rise. It drifted up, settled on the board, and spelled out lessons nobody had taught in decades.
scenes.image: chalk dust floating upward off a chalkboard tray in a dark classroom, glowing faintly

scenes.narration: Outside the window, the parking lot was full. Old cars. Rounded fenders. Whitewall tires.
scenes.image: a parking lot at night filled with 1940s cars under a single sodium lamp

scenes.narration: Footsteps in the hallway. Slow. Patient. The steps of a man who has never once been late.
scenes.image: the shadow of a man in a suit and hat on frosted door glass

scenes.narration: The door opened. Mr. Grey hung his hat on the hook and said: detention, Miss Dunn. We have so much to cover.
scenes.image: a thin man in a grey suit standing in a classroom doorway, holding his hat, smiling faintly
